name: Bethany
overview: Bethany is a significant biblical village where Jesus lodged and was honored during his ministry, as seen when he stayed there after leaving the city (Matthew 21:17) and attended a meal at the house of Simon the leper (Matthew 26:6). It is also the place where a woman anointed Jesus with costly ointment, an act Jesus affirmed as a good work despite the disciples' objections about waste (Matthew 26:7-10). These events highlight Bethany as a setting of intimate fellowship and worship centered on Christ.
